author: ABMN Staff
title: Apple (AAPL) PT Lowered to $157.00
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Apr 30th, 2018 // No Comments
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its target price lowered by Barclays from $168.00 to $157.00 in a report issued on Monday. The brokerage presently has an “equal weight” rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. Barclays’ price objective would suggest a potential downside of 3.42% from the stock’s previous close.
Several other research firms have also recently weighed in on AAPL. ValuEngine upgraded shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating in a research report on Sunday, December 31st. Rosenblatt Securities set a $180.00 price objective on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday, January 1st. Piper Jaffray restated a “buy” rating and issued a $200.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, January 2nd. Zacks Investment Research upgraded shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $190.00 price objective for the company in a research report on Wednesday, January 3rd. Finally, UBS set a $190.00 price objective on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Friday, January 5th. Two research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-two have issued a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. Apple currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $202.91. Get Apple alerts:
NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $162.56 on Monday. Apple has a 1 year low of $142.20 and a 1 year high of $183.50. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. The company has a market capitalization of $823,613.88, a PE ratio of 17.65, a PEG ratio of 1.24 and a beta of 1.25. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $87.62 billion. During the same quarter in the previous year, the company posted $3.36 earnings per share. Apple’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. sell-side analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.3 EPS for the current year.
In other Apple news, SVP Daniel J. Riccio sold 17,375 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction dated Wednesday, April 4th. The shares were sold at an average price of $169.12, for a total transaction of $2,938,460.00. Following the sale, the senior vice president now directly owns 66,191 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $11,194,221.92. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at this link . Also, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction dated Tuesday, April 3rd. The stock was sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total transaction of $11,564,692.22. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold a total of 125,988 shares of company stock worth $21,336,201 over the last three months. Insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
A number of large investors have recently modified their holdings of AAPL. University of Texas Investment Managment Co. bought a new stake in shares of Apple in the 4th quarter valued at about $114,000. FNY Managed Accounts LLC raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 852.4% in the 2nd quarter. FNY Managed Accounts LLC now owns 800 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $115,000 after purchasing an additional 716 shares during the period. Private Vista LLC bought a new stake in shares of Apple in the 2nd quarter valued at about $122,000. Santori & Peters Inc. bought a new stake in shares of Apple in the 4th quarter valued at about $149,000. Finally, Oak Point Wealth Management bought a new stake in shares of Apple in the 4th quarter valued at about $163,000. 61.18% of the stock is currently owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
